arxiv-2005-11247.title: Evaluating Generalisation in General Video Game Playing PubID: pubid: 978-1-7281-4533-4/20/$31.00 ©2020 IEEE
arxiv-2005-11247.creator: Martin Balla, Simon M. Lucas, Diego Perez-Liebana
arxiv-2005-11247.description: Abstract The General Video Game Artificial Intelligence (GVGAI) competition has been running for several years with various tracks. This paper focuses on the challenge of the GVGAI learning track in which 3 games are selected and 2 levels are given for training, while 3 hidden levels are left for evaluation.

arxiv-2101-08402.title: Resolving VLBI correlator ambiguity in the time delay model improves precision of geodetic measurements DOI: 10.1017/pas.2026.xxx
arxiv-2101-08402.creator: O. Titov 1, A. Melnikov 2, and Y. Lopez 3
arxiv-2101-08402.description: Abstract The modern Very Long Baseline Interferometry (VLBI) relativistic delay model, as documented in the IERS Conventions refers to the time epoch when the signal passes one of two stations of an interferometer baseline (selected arbitrarily from the pair of stations and called the “reference station”, or "station 1").

arxiv-2103-12865.title: Privacy-preserving Identity Broadcast for Contact Tracing Applications
arxiv-2103-12865.creator: Vladimir Dyo, Jahangir Ali
arxiv-2103-12865.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Vladimir Dyo, Jahangir Ali. Wireless Contact tracing has emerged as an important tool for managing the COVID19 pandemic and relies on continuous broadcasting of a person’s presence using Bluetooth Low Energy beacons. The limitation of current contact tracing systems in that a reception of a s ​ i ​ n ​ g ​ l ​ e single beacon is sufficient to reveal the user identity, potentially exposing users to malicious trackers installed along the roads, passageways, and other infrastructure.

Citations should use the original version of the paper ( Arvidsson et al. 2023 ) . CCS: Software and
arxiv-2309-02983.creator: Ellen Arvidsson, Elias Castegren, Sylvan Clebsch, Sophia Drossopoulou, James Noble, Matthew J. Parkinson, Tobias Wrigstad
arxiv-2309-02983.description: Abstract . Verona is a concurrent object-oriented programming language that organises all the objects in a program into a forest of isolated regions. Memory is managed locally for each region, so programmers can control a program’s memory use by adjusting objects’ partition into regions, and by setting each region’s memory management strategy.

arxiv-2309-15653.title: Direct Sensing of Remote Nuclei: Expanding the Reach of Cross-Effect Dynamic Nuclear Polarization
arxiv-2309-15653.creator: Amaria Javed, Asif Equbal
arxiv-2309-15653.description: Abstract Dynamic Nuclear Polarization (DNP) has revolutionized the field of solid-state NMR spectroscopy by significantly enhancing the sensitivity of nuclear magnetic resonance experiments. Conventionally, cross effect DNP relies on biradicals to transfer polarization from coupled electron spins to nearby nuclear spins and subsequent relay to target nuclei via spin diffusion mechanism.

arxiv-2312-09340.title: Asymptotics of the centre mode instability in viscoelastic channel flow: with and without inertia
arxiv-2312-09340.creator: Rich R. Kerswell 1 \ns and Jacob Page 2
arxiv-2312-09340.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Rich R. Kerswell 1 \ns and Jacob Page 2. Motivated by the recent numerical results of Khalid et al., Phys. , 127 134502 (2021), we consider the large-Weissenberg-number ( W W ) asymptotics of the centre mode instability in inertialess viscoelastic channel flow.

arxiv-2403-06300.title: Cross-ecosystem categorization: A manual-curation protocol for the categorization of Java Maven libraries along Python PyPI Topics
arxiv-2403-06300.creator: Ranindya Paramitha, Yuan Feng, Fabio Massacci, Carlos E. Budde
arxiv-2403-06300.description: Abstract Context: Software of different functional categories, such as text processing vs. networking, has different profiles in terms of metrics like security and updates. Using popularity to compare e.g. Java vs. Python libraries might give a skewed perspective, as the categories of the most popular software vary from one ecosystem to the next.

arxiv-2406-10320.title: Out of style: Misadventures with LLMs and code style transfer
arxiv-2406-10320.creator: Karl Munson, Chih-Kai Ting, Serenity Wade, Anish Savla, Julian Dolby, Kiran Kate, Kavitha Srinivas
arxiv-2406-10320.description: Abstract Like text, programs have styles, and certain programming styles are more desirable than others for program readability, maintainability, and performance. Code style transfer, however, is difficult to automate except for trivial style guidelines such as limits on line length.

arxiv-2409-12097.title: Skill matching at scale: freelancer-project alignment for efficient multilingual candidate retrieval
arxiv-2409-12097.creator: Warren Jouanneau, Marc Palyart, Emma Jouffroy
arxiv-2409-12097.description: Abstract Finding the perfect match between a job proposal and a set of freelancers is not an easy task to perform at scale, especially in multiple languages. In this paper, we propose a novel neural retriever architecture that tackles this problem in a multilingual setting. Our method encodes project descriptions and freelancer profiles by leveraging pre-trained multilingual language models.

arxiv-2501-02178.title: The Application of Large Language Models in Recommendation Systems
arxiv-2501-02178.creator: Peiyang Yu, Zeqiu Xu, Jiani Wang, Xiaochuan Xu
arxiv-2501-02178.description: Abstract The integration of Large Language Models into recommendation frameworks presents key advantages for personalization and adaptability of experiences to the users. Classic recommendation methods, such as collaborative filtering and content-based filtering, are seriously limited in solving cold-start problems, data sparsity, and lack of diversity in the information considered.

arxiv-2505-24549.title: Strongly driven transmon as an incoherent noise source
arxiv-2505-24549.creator: Linda Greggio, Rémi Robin, Mazyar Mirrahimi, Alexandru Petrescu
arxiv-2505-24549.description: Abstract Under strong drives, which are becoming necessary for fast high-fidelity operations, transmons can be structurally unstable. Due to chaotic effects, the computational manifold is no longer well separated from the remainder of the spectrum, which correlates with enhanced offset-charge sensitivity and destructive effects in readout.

arxiv-2510-25162.title: Response to Comment from Robert Cousins on Confidence intervals for the Poisson distribution Note: Work supported in part by the U.S. Department of Energy, Office of Science, Office of High Energy Physics, under Award Number DE-SC0011925.
arxiv-2510-25162.creator: Frank C. Porter
arxiv-2510-25162.description: Abstract Robert Cousins has posted a comment on my manuscript on “Confidence intervals for the Poisson distribution”. His key point is that one should not include in the likelihood non-physical parameter values, even for frequency statistics. This is my response, in which I contend that it can be useful to do so when discussing such descriptive statistics.

plos-pone-0004976.creator: Henk Tjebbe vanderLeest, Jos H. T. Rohling, Stephan Michel et al.
plos-pone-0004976.description: PLOS ONE research article. In mammals, a major circadian pacemaker that drives daily rhythms is located in the suprachiasmatic nuclei (SCN), at the base of the hypothalamus. The SCN receive direct light input via the retino-hypothalamic tract. Light during the early night induces phase delays of circadian

pmc-10757021.title: Brief Report: Droplet Digital Polymerase Chain Reaction Versus Plasma Next-Generation Sequencing in Detecting Clearance of Plasma EGFR Mutations and Carcinoembryonic Antigen Levels as a Surrogate Measure
pmc-10757021.creator: Stephanie PL Saw, Gek San Tan, Wei Chong Tan, Aaron C Tan, Gillianne GY Lai, Darren WT Lim, Ravindran Kanesvaran, Wan Ling Tan, Sze Huey Tan, Kiat Hon Lim, Anders J Skanderup, Daniel SW Tan
pmc-10757021.description: IntroductionTo compare the performance of droplet digital polymerase chain reaction (ddPCR) and plasma next-generation sequencing (NGS) in detecting clearance of plasma EGFR (pEGFR) mutations.MethodsPatients with treatment-naive advanced EGFR-mutated lung cancer treated with first-line tyrosine kinase inhibitors (TKIs) were included. pEGFR were measured at baseline and first response assessment using ddPCR and NGS.

pmc-11341760.title: Topical metronidazole after haemorrhoidectomy to reduce postoperative pain: a systematic review
pmc-11341760.creator: Chiara Eberspacher, Domenico Mascagni, Stefano Pontone, Francesco Leone Arcieri, Stefano Arcieri
pmc-11341760.description: Excisional haemorrhoidectomy is the gold standard for operating haemorrhoids, but it is accompanied by a significant problem: postoperative pain. Several strategies have been adopted to minimize this condition. Oral metronidazole has been proven to reduce postoperative pain but with some complications.

pmc-11503863.title: Effect of Gestational Direct-Fed Microbials Supplementation on the Metabolic Profile in Periparturient Dairy Cows
pmc-11503863.creator: Orlando Ramirez-Garzon, David Barber, Loreto Meneses, Martin Soust
pmc-11503863.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Simple SummaryThis study at a commercial dairy farm in Queensland, Australia, evaluated the effects of a lactic acid bacteria-based direct-fed microbial (DFM) on periparturient dairy cows. A total of 150 Holstein cows were divided into control and DFM groups, with the latter receiving a basal diet supplemented with three strains of bacteria from the genus formerly known as Lactobacillus but recently assigned to the new Lentilactobacillus and Lacticaseibacillus genera.

pmc-11656954.title: Advancing diagnosis and early risk assessment of preeclampsia through noninvasive cell-free DNA methylation profiling
pmc-11656954.creator: Machteld Baetens, Bram Van Gaever, Stephanie Deblaere, Andries De Koker, Leander Meuris, Nico Callewaert, Sandra Janssens, Kristien Roelens, Ellen Roets, Jo Van Dorpe, Isabelle Dehaene, Björn Menten
pmc-11656954.description: BackgroundAberrant embryo implantation and suboptimal placentation can lead to (severe) complications such as preeclampsia and fetal growth restriction later in pregnancy. Current identification of high-risk pregnancies relies on a combination of risk factors, biomarkers, and ultrasound examinations, a relatively inaccurate approach.

pmc-12642996.title: Guide to dynamic OCT data analysis
pmc-12642996.creator: Noah Heldt, Tual Monfort, Rion Morishita, Robert Schönherr, Olivier Thouvenin, Ibrahim Abd El-Sadek, Peter König, Gereon Hüttmann, Kate Grieve, Yoshiaki Yasuno
pmc-12642996.description: Dynamic optical coherence tomography (DOCT) enhances conventional OCT by providing specific information related to flow dynamics, cell motility, and organelle metabolic activity. These biological phenomena can be detected with varying sensitivity depending on the OCT architecture parameters, including wavelength, numerical aperture, and implementation method (time domain or Fourier domain).

pmc-13431786.creator: Nguyen Van Trang, Le Anh Tuan, Chu Thi Ngoc Mai, Le Thi Khanh Ly, Tran Hoang My Lien, Nguyen Thanh Chung, Dao Thi Thanh Huyen, Nguyen Thi To Uyen, Nham Thi Tuyen Thanh, Tran Thi Hong Nhung, Chau Quang, Claire Von Mollendorf, Gerald Murray, Suzanne M Garland, Kathryn Bright, Paul V Licciardi, Kim Mulholland, Zheng Quan Toh

pmc-13675443.title: Cross-domain signal grammars of transcription termination
pmc-13675443.creator: Shouqing Hou, Hongru Ma, Xuye Lang, Yuan Yao
pmc-13675443.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Transcription termination establishes gene boundaries, recycles RNA polymerase, and prevents interference between neighboring transcription units. Termination depends on cis-acting elements, trans-acting factors, and the susceptibility of the elongation complex to pausing, cleavage, destabilization, or release. Predicted motifs, stable RNA ends, processing sites, readthrough regions, and polymerase-release regions are nevertheless often treated as measurements of the same event, which complicates mechanistic comparison and model development.
